question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

You will ______ the price for this crime.
solution:
The correct answer is "**pay."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• "**Pay**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It means to give money in exchange for something, which fits the context of the sentence.(वेतन)
 
 
• Example: You need to pay for what you have used.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be : You will pay__ the price for this crime.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Make" means to cause or compel someone to do something.(बनाना)

 
 
• ​Example: I think you are making a mistake.
 
 
 
• "Pale" means to become less intense or vivid.(फीका)
 
 
• Example: Your skin is looking very pale today.
 
 
 
• "Call" means to make a phone call or shout. (पुकारना)
 
 
• Example: You need to call your manager regarding this.
